data.one_liner: Dart client package for routing APIs like OSRM and Valhalla.
data.what_it_does: Provides API clients and managers for routing, trip services, and navigation instructions using OSRM and Valhalla backends. It handles waypoints, geometries, polylines, and checks if a location is on a path.
use_when: You need to fetch routes or travel paths from an OSRM or Valhalla backend in Dart.
You want to calculate trip optimizations or extract navigation instructions and check if a location is on a path.
avoid_when: You are looking for a fully-featured interactive map widget (this package is for routing data only).
You use routing backends other than OSRM or Valhalla (unless supported via coming soon updates).
strengths: Supports multiple routing backends (OSRM and Valhalla).
Includes path checking and next-instruction navigation helpers.
weaknesses: Documentation is sparse and requires checking code/README for details.
Certain instruction features may contain inaccurate information as noted by the author.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and instantiate RoutingManager with your request configurations.
